_doc: The video the human plays on their phone in S45-S46 (scripts/phone_dialer.py -> deliverables/phone/): an invented dialer, no real phone's interface. The pledge number is typed on the post-roll's DTMF timing (config/postroll.json), the call screen shows 'Calling' over the ring, then 'On hold' with a timer through the hold music, until the hang-up. Its sound is the post-roll's to the hang-up, so the tones heard on set line up with the post mix (R2). Times are seconds from the song's end (post-roll time), except lead_in.
lead_in_note: the empty keypad before the first digit, to start the video and lift the phone
hang_up_note: 4 s into S46 (8 s long): listen, hang up, then 4 s to fold the sheet into the guitar case
